summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Panel features for ClearFile NG. Backend API testing achieved 100% success rate (16/16 tests passed). Frontend testing validated admin panel UI including stats cards, tabs, filters, request expansion, and user management.

design_issues.issue: Console warning about chart width/height being -1 on initial load. Charts render correctly after data loads.
design_issues.note: Known Recharts issue with ResponsiveContainer - does not affect functionality

backend: POST /api/auth/login with admin@clearfileng.com / ClearFileNG2024! returns role=admin
GET /api/auth/me returns role field for admin user
GET /api/admin/stats returns user count (14), transaction count (71), expert request breakdown (pending:1, matched:2)
GET /api/admin/expert-requests returns list of all requests
PUT /api/admin/expert-requests/{id}/status with matched + expert details creates match
GET /api/admin/users returns user list (14 users) without password_hash
frontend: Admin Panel accessible at /admin for admin users
Admin Panel shows stats cards (14 Users, 71 Transactions, 1 Pending, 2 Matched)
Expert Requests tab shows request list with status/urgency badges
Status filter buttons work (All, Pending, Reviewing, Matched, InProgress, Completed)
Clicking a request expands it showing user details (Email, Phone, Business, Budget)
Expanded view shows User Notes section
Expanded view shows Matched Expert info when applicable
Expanded view shows Admin Notes section with existing notes
Status change buttons available (Reviewing, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled)
Admin note input field available in expanded view
Users tab shows user list (14 users) with names and emails
Users tab shows business type badges (Freelancer, Company, Sme)
Users tab shows plan dropdown selectors (Starter, Pro)
Admin user has crown icon in Users tab
Admin Panel link appears in sidebar only for admin users (code verified)

admin_dashboard_stats.details: Returns total_users, total_transactions, expert_requests breakdown (total, pending, matched, completed), plan_breakdown

expert_request_management.details: Full CRUD for expert requests - list, filter by status, update status, match with expert, add admin notes

user_management.details: List users without password_hash, update subscription plan

admin_access_control.details: Non-admin users get 403 on all admin endpoints. Admin nav link only shows for role=admin users.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin panel implementation is complete and working correctly
Role-based access control properly implemented at both backend (require_admin dependency) and frontend (user.role check)
Admin nav link conditionally rendered based on user.role === 'admin'
Password hash correctly excluded from user list response
Status validation properly rejects invalid values with 400
seed_data_creation: Admin user auto-seeded on startup with role='admin'. Test expert requests and admin notes created during testing with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Panel fully tested and working. Features: (1) Dashboard stats showing users, transactions, expert request breakdown. (2) Expert Requests tab with filtering, expand/collapse detail view, status updates, expert matching form, admin notes. (3) Users tab with plan dropdown to update subscription. (4) Role-based access control - non-admin users get 403 on API and see 'Admin Access Required' message on frontend. Admin nav link only visible for admin users.
